zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 更完整的本机截图工作流
changes: 新增重复上次区域、精确宽高、比例锁定、键盘微调和截图后快速结果浮层
扩展本机标注与识别能力，加入 OCR、裁剪旋转、更多图形工具及文字、条码和人脸智能脱敏
贴图支持导入图片、透明度与显示范围控制；历史支持保留策略、OCR 搜索和多图拼板
提供 URL Scheme 与 macOS 快捷指令自动化入口，并完善截图工具栏和拖拽交互
应用、Sparkle 更新 ZIP 和手动安装 DMG 均已签名并通过 Apple 公证

en.label: Latest
en.title: A more complete on-device capture workflow
changes: Adds repeat-region capture, exact dimensions, aspect locking, keyboard adjustments, and a quick result overlay after capture.
Expands on-device annotation and recognition with OCR, crop and rotate, more drawing tools, and smart redaction for text, barcodes, and faces.
Pins gain image import, opacity, and visibility controls; history gains retention options, OCR search, and multi-image boards.
Adds URL scheme and macOS Shortcuts automation while refining the capture toolbar and drag interactions.
The app, Sparkle update ZIP, and manual-install DMG are signed and notarized by Apple.
